optionalNative.ajiReleaseBoundary: The current official v0.22.2 ABI-9 runtime and historical private ABI-8 Native builds are distinct cohorts, recorded in native/manifest/sources.json and components.json. Neither is cleared for public redistribution; earlier v0.17.1 installations are separate on-disk records, not this cohort. The separate Linux aji-encode asset is an optional offline CLI, not a playback dependency and not automatically acquired or shipped; its FFmpeg dependency and rights require separate assessment. The Windows aji-trtrtx-windows-x64.zip overlay is the opt-in TensorRT-for-RTX backend for Windows Standard playback: acquired only after explicit user action into the per-machine store, never included in the base installer or any distribution, and never auto-downloaded at startup. Its aji_trtrtx.dll remains ESC-1-blocked, and its bundled NVIDIA runtime is proprietary under the NVIDIA TensorRT for RTX Software License Agreement with both NVIDIA notices required and preserved locally; no redistribution clearance is claimed and there is no Linux RTX asset. Upstream builds against TensorRT 11.4 while the pinned packs here stay at 11.3; that build line is not a statement of the deployed runtime.
optionalNative.note: This exclusion is not clearance. ESC-4 remains resolved only for its recorded DirectML component; no ESC status is altered by this package manifest.
